comment: The LG firmware (Settings > All Settings > Support > TV Information, Software Version) and model families HomeTV's root edition may take Home over on. install.sh refuses a TV not listed here unless the owner agreed (hometv-lg asks; --unlisted-ok), and the start-up hook leaves LG's Home alone after the software changed to one not listed. A family is the model name without the size and region (43UT8000AUA: UT80); no families: any model on that firmware. A trailing * in firmware matches a prefix. status: tested (on a TV by us), reported (others' reports, linked in note), planned (not tried yet). The idea is lasharor/cleanyourtv-WebOS's compat.json (MIT, read at 2debe62).

entries.note: the test TV (43UT8000AUA, webOS 25) before its 2026 update; root planned on it, the takeover not tried
the test TV since 2026-11-17; the takeover is first tried on the TV call
